run_uncompress_s2ef_datasets: run the uncompress script to decompress lzma compressed S2EF dataset files in parallel using multiprocessing
run_read_lzma: run the read_lzma function to decompress a single lzma compressed file to an output path
run_decompress_list_of_files: run the decompress_list_of_files function to decompress a single input output file pair using lzma
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to get an argparse parser with ipdir opdir and num_workers arguments
run_main: run the main function to find and decompress all txt.xz and extxyz.xz files in a directory using a multiprocessing pool
